content: Uca lallas Naɛumi tenna as: “A yeǧi, ma tuɣa war ttexseɣ ad am afeɣ amcan n řaman ḥima ad tiřid mliḥ?
Ma war iǧi Buɛaz, i ɣar tuɣa cem jar temsexxarin nnes, d ijjen zi raǧ nneɣ? Xzar, ass-a ɣar tmeddit, ad izzuzar imendi deg unedrar.
Sird, dhen ixef nnem uca yarḍ taqendurt nnem, xenni hwa-dd ɣar unedrar! War seccan ixef nnem i weryaz ař ɣa yiři icca iswa.
Mařa iraḥ ad iṭṭeṣ, ad tiři ad tarzud amcan mani izzeř. Adef xenni ɣar din, tɛarrid x dduri x iḍaren nnes uca zzeř dinni! Netta ad am yini xenni, min ittxeṣṣa ad t tegged.”
Nettat tarra-dd xas: “Marra min d ayi teqqared, ad t ggeɣ.”
Nettat tehwa ɣar unedrar uca tegga amenni qaɛ min tuɣa d as tenna lallas.
Řami icca iswa Buɛaz, ifarḥ wuř nnes, ikkar yuyur, ḥima ad izzeř ɣar ṭṭarf n ijj n uɛurric n tqebbiḍin n imendi. Xenni tusa-dd břa řḥess, tɛarra x dduri ɣar iḍaren nnes uca tezzeř.
Ɣar wezyen n ǧiřet innexřeɛ weryaz nni, inneqřeb, uca xzar, ict n temɣart tuɣa tezzeř ɣar iḍaren nnes.
Netta inna: “Min teɛnid cem?” Nettat tarra-dd xas: “Necc d Raɛut, tayya nnec. Egg maca afriw nnec x tayya nnec, maɣar cek d wenni izemmaren ad ayi ifdi.”

Inna netta: “Tettwabarked cem zi SIDI, a yeǧi! Řexxu deg uneggar teggid tamexsiwt nnem icewwaren mahu s min teggid deg umezwaru, maɣar cem war tuzziřed awarni i iɛezriyyen, imezřaḍ niɣ ayt n bu wagřa.
Xenni řexxu, a yeǧi, war tteggʷed ca! Marra min ɣa tinid, ad am t ggeɣ, maɣar qaɛ wi da di tewwart n tendint n řgens inu issen, aqa cem d ict n temɣart temḥeḍ.
Řexxu xenni, d tidett necc d ijj n umefdi, maca din ɛad ijj n umefdi nneɣni, wenni d am itteɛnan ktar xafi necc.

Seɛdu ǧiřet-a da. Mařa imsar tiwecca di ṣṣbeḥ, netta ixs ad xam ifdi, mliḥ, xenni ejj i-t ad ifdi, maca mařa netta war ixs ad cem ifdi, xenni necc ad xam fdiɣ, s tidett xenni am iddar SIDI. Qqim zzeř ař tiwecca.”
Ammu i teqqim tezzeř ɣar iḍaren nnes ař tiwecca uca qbeř ma izemmar ijj ad iẓar wenneɣni, tekkar, maɣar netta inna: “War tᵉttiři tᵉttwassnen, aqa ict n temɣart tuɣa tusa-dd ɣar unedrar”
Netta inna ɛawed: “Ksi tacḍaḍt i zi třeḥḥfed, ṭṭef i-tt!” Uca netta iccur i-tt s setta n řeqyasat n imendi uca issarbu tt xas. Xenni yudef ɣar tendint.
Tusa-dd nettat ɣar lallas u tanita tesseqsa: “Min teɛnid cem, a yeǧi?” Nettat tḥaja as marra min kis igga weryaz nni.
Tenna: “Setta n řeqyas-a n imendi iwca ayi ten, maɣar netta inna: ‘Cem war teggured ca ɣar lallam s ifassen ixwan.’”
Xenni tenna Naɛumi: “Raja, a yeǧi, qqim da ař ɣa tessned mammec ɣa teffeɣ tmesřact. Minzi aryaz nni war ittareyyiḥ ca ař dd-issuffeɣ tamesřact ɛad ass-a ɣar uneggar nnes.”

footnotes.text: Min teɛnid cem, a yeǧi?- ixs ad yini ‘Mammec teǧid, a yeǧi?’
